reuse.why: The tree already exports getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts (null to 0, number as-is, range at the end furthest from zero), used by forecast and schedules/app, but the diff writes its own getExpectedScheduleAmount instead of calling it.

duplication.why: getExpectedScheduleAmount duplicates the whole getScheduledAmount decision, with a different tie-break (> instead of >=) that can already drift.

placement.why: Mapping the field in scheduleModel.toExternal is the right layer, but the amount rule itself belongs in shared/schedules.ts, not a private helper in api-models.ts.

scope.why: Only the API model, its type and a focused test are changed.

maintainability.why: A second private copy of the expected-amount rule means a future rule change (e.g. worst case for income) will silently miss the API.

disguised_duplication.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount in api-models.ts: getScheduledAmount's null/number/range logic renamed, with the checks reordered and the comparison flipped (num1 > num2 instead of >=).
